description: Only when the user asks to star, favourite or save a skill (for example "star this skill", "save this one", "unstar it"): stars or unstars that skill for this user. A starred skill is ranked first by find_skill whenever it fits a task, and never shown when it does not. Pass the Source and Skill that find_skill printed; set starred to false to unstar. Never call it on your own initiative. Reply with the returned line.

source.description: The Source printed by find_skill, usually owner/repository. Leave it out only when the skill was in this session's last find_skill result

starred.description: true (the default) stars the skill; false unstars it

name: star_skill
title: Edge Skills: star a skill
